text:
[Act: limitation
 Chapter: First Division · Part II · Suits Relating to Contracts
 Section: 36::Three years.
]


On a promissory note or bond payable by instalments.
Period of limitationThree years.
Time from which period begins to runThe expiration of the first term of payment as to the part then payable; and for the other parts, the expiration of the respective terms of payment.
